orgs.name: 01.AI
orgs.notes: 01.AI (零一万物) is a private Chinese AI company focused on developing open-source products. It began operations in June 2023; the text says it received backing from Alibaba Group and Xiaomi, but does not identify a parent organization.

orgs.name: Adept AI
orgs.notes: Adept AI Labs Inc. is an active, for-profit research and product AI lab that builds general artificial intelligence and automates software processes. The text identifies it as a unicorn company and lists Series B as its last funding type.

orgs.name: Advanced Machine Intelligence Labs (AMI Labs)
orgs.notes: AMI Labs is a Paris-based AI research laboratory focused on world-model systems that understand the physical world, maintain long-term memory, and plan complex tasks. It raised $1.03 billion in seed funding in March 2026 and is not expected to produce a saleable product for around five years.

orgs.name: Anthropic
orgs.notes: Anthropic was founded in January 2021 by seven former OpenAI employees, including Dario and Daniela Amodei. It is a privately held public benefit corporation; its flagship product is Claude.

orgs.name: Character.AI
orgs.notes: Character.AI is a generative AI chatbot service founded by former Google engineers Noam Shazeer and Daniel de Freitas. It filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October 2026 and agreed to sell assets to The Walt Disney Company for $20 million.

orgs.name: Cohere
orgs.notes: Cohere is a Canadian AI company founded in 2019, specializing in large language models and enterprise AI products. In September 2026, it signed a definitive merger agreement with Aleph Alpha; the proposed combined company is to have headquarters in Toronto and Berlin, subject to regulatory approval.

orgs.name: Google DeepMind
orgs.notes: DeepMind was incorporated in September 2010 and officially launched in November 2010; Google acquired it in January 2014, and it merged with Google Brain in April 2023 to form Google DeepMind. It is a subsidiary of Alphabet; in December 2019 co-founder Mustafa Suleyman left for a policy role at Google, and an August 2026 report said Demis Hassabis was stepping into a new role, without specifying details.

orgs.name: DeepSeek
orgs.notes: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI company that develops open-weight large language models. High-Flyer is identified as its owner and principal backer; Liang Wenfeng is its CEO.

orgs.name: Essential AI
orgs.notes: Essential AI is developing full-stack AI products and LLMs to automate enterprise workflows and increase productivity. The text reports a $56.5 million Series A led by March Capital and an earlier $8.3 million seed round led by Thrive Capital, for nearly $65 million raised in total.

orgs.name: Eureka Labs
orgs.notes: Karpathy announced Eureka Labs’ founding on July 16, 2024. The company aims to create an AI Native School, and its first course will teach students to create a large language model from scratch; Karpathy said generative AI could help teachers reach more students across languages with AI teaching assistants.

orgs.name: Google Brain
orgs.notes: Google Brain began as a research collaboration at Google X and later became part of Google AI. In April 2023, it merged with DeepMind to form Google DeepMind.

orgs.name: Hugging Face
orgs.notes: Founded in New York City as a teen-focused chatbot company, Hugging Face later pivoted to a machine-learning platform. The text says it operates as a wholly owned Nvidia subsidiary, but also says Nvidia’s acquisition agreement was announced in September 2026 and is expected to close in the first half of 2027. Parent left null: acquisition by Nvidia was announced September 2026 and had not closed per the source.

orgs.name: Inflection AI
orgs.notes: Inflection AI is a private American AI company and public benefit corporation. Its product includes the chatbot Pi; in 2024, Microsoft licensed its technology and hired nearly the entirety of its 70-person workforce.

orgs.name: Meta AI (FAIR)
orgs.notes: Founded in 2013 as Facebook AI Research (FAIR), the division continued as Meta’s Fundamental AI Research team after Facebook rebranded as Meta Platforms in 2021. In 2025, FAIR and other AI research and product groups were brought together under Meta Superintelligence Labs.

orgs.name: Meta Superintelligence Labs
orgs.notes: Meta announced the establishment of Meta Superintelligence Labs on June 30, 2025, with Alexandr Wang leading it and Nat Friedman heading AI products. The division focuses on artificial superintelligence research and development.

orgs.name: Microsoft AI
orgs.notes: Microsoft AI was established as a Microsoft division overseeing Copilot and other consumer AI products; Microsoft's previous AI team was absorbed into it. The text does not identify any people as founders of Microsoft AI. Led by CEO Mustafa Suleyman from its creation in March 2024.

orgs.name: Mistral AI
orgs.notes: Mistral AI is a French artificial intelligence company founded in April 2023 to develop large language models. The text identifies Arthur Mensch as CEO, Guillaume Lample as Chief Scientist, and Timothée Lacroix as CTO.

orgs.name: Moonshot AI
orgs.notes: Moonshot AI is a private artificial intelligence company founded in Beijing. Yang Zhilin is its CEO; the text identifies Alibaba Group and Tencent as investors, not as parent organizations.

orgs.name: NEAR (NEAR.ai / NEAR Protocol)
orgs.notes: The text says Illia Polosukhin and Alexander Skidanov founded NEAR Protocol in 2018 to build a scalable, usable blockchain. It does not state a headquarters or parent organization.

orgs.name: OpenAI
orgs.parent: OpenAI Foundation (holds a stake in OpenAI Group PBC and appoints its board)
orgs.notes: Founded as the nonprofit OpenAI, Inc. in December 2015; its for-profit arm became OpenAI Group PBC in 2025. The company develops generative AI models and products including GPT and ChatGPT.

orgs.name: Periodic Labs
orgs.notes: Co-founded by former OpenAI researcher Liam Fedus and former Google DeepMind researcher Ekin Dogus Cubuk (per company site founding team and reporting). Periodic Labs' own description is an AI research and deployment company building AI scientists and autonomous laboratories, initially focused on the physical sciences. The text says its founding team has contributed to projects including ChatGPT, DeepMind’s GNoME, OpenAI’s Operator, the neural attention mechanism, and MatterGen; it does not state a founding date, parent organization, or headquarters.

orgs.name: Perplexity
orgs.notes: Perplexity AI, Inc. is a privately held American software company offering an AI-powered search engine. Aravind Srinivas is identified as CEO and co-founder.

orgs.name: Reflection AI
orgs.notes: Reflection AI is an American AI company developing open foundation models and software agents for AI-assisted software development. It also has offices in San Francisco and London.

orgs.name: Reka AI
orgs.notes: Reka emerged from stealth on June 27, 2023, announcing $58 million in funding. Its first commercial product, Yasa, is a multimodal AI assistant that can be adapted to company data. Founding date not stated; emerged from stealth 2023-06.

orgs.name: Sakana AI
orgs.notes: Sakana AI researches the evolution and collective intelligence of AI. It raised $30 million in seed funding and approximately $200 million in a 2024 Series A; The Nikkei estimated its value at 19 billion yen in 2024.

orgs.name: Scale AI
orgs.notes: Scale AI was founded in 2016 and provides AI data, evaluation, and software services. Meta acquired a 49% non-voting stake in 2025; the text says Scale AI remained a standalone, independent entity.

orgs.name: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
orgs.notes: Founded to focus on safely developing superintelligence; Meta’s attempted acquisition was rebuffed in the first half of 2025. In July 2025, Daniel Gross left for Meta Superintelligence Labs and Sutskever became SSI’s CEO; in July 2026, SSI announced a strategic partnership with Nvidia.

orgs.name: Stability AI
orgs.notes: Stability AI is a UK-based artificial intelligence company best known for Stable Diffusion. The text does not state a parent organization or a founding month.

orgs.name: Thinking Machines Lab
orgs.notes: Thinking Machines Lab is a San Francisco-based AI startup and public benefit corporation. It raised $2 billion in a 2025 funding round at a $12 billion valuation; the text also identifies Lilian Weng and John Schulman as members of its founding team.

orgs.name: Windsurf (formerly Codeium)
orgs.notes: The founders started Exafunction, a GPU virtualization software company, then pivoted after their Series A to build the AI coding platform Codeium. They later expanded from an IDE extension to an agentic IDE named Windsurf.

orgs.name: World Labs
orgs.notes: World Labs is a frontier AI research and product company focused on spatial and physical intelligence. Its first product, Marble, uses generative 3D world models to create spatially coherent, high-fidelity, persistent 3D worlds.

orgs.name: xAI
orgs.notes: Founded as xAI in March 2023; SpaceX acquired it on February 2, 2026, and it was rebranded as SpaceXAI in July 2026. The text identifies Elon Musk as founder and names the researchers on the founding team, led by Igor Babuschkin.

orgs.name: Zhipu AI (Z.ai)
orgs.parent: Tsinghua University (spun out as an independent company)
orgs.notes: The company began at Tsinghua University and later became independent; it rebranded internationally as Z.ai in 2025. It held its IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 8 January 2026.

orgs.name: Discovery Loop
orgs.notes: Startup aiming to automate scientific research loops. Alphabet joined its seed round and holds a stake; Google is its cloud partner. Founding month is the month of the reported departures.
orgs.source_title: Wilson Sonsini: Discovery Loop launch and initial funding
